einzeiler: An 89-year-old shares her bold plans to backpack across Europe and start a new chapter.
kurzfassung: Mel Robbins takes a walk in Vermont with her 89-year-old mother-in-law, who recently announced her plan to backpack through Europe for a year. The conversation explores the themes of aging, breaking out of comfortable routines, and refusing to put off life's adventures. The episode encourages listeners to stop making excuses and embrace new experiences before time runs out.
stichpunkte: An 89-year-old mother-in-law decides to backpack through Europe for a year with her partner.
The decision was sparked by a realization about mortality and the fading popularity of traditional pastimes like bridge.
Routine can quietly consume decades, leading people to feel stuck without realizing they can change at any age.
Witnessing the sudden death of a peer reinforces the philosophy of not waiting to take desired trips.
Many older adults hesitate to spend their savings due to a perceived obligation to leave inheritances.
Maintaining curiosity about others prevents people from becoming isolated and boring as they age.
Shift from contemplating a major change to committing to it unlocks mental clarity and new possibilities.

clips.hook: The danger of losing curiosity as you age.
clips.text: A core philosophy is shared regarding social interaction, noting that individuals who fail to show genuine curiosity about others ultimately become dull and unappealing company.

clips.hook: The true meaning behind the word present.
clips.text: The conversation concludes with a classic play on words explaining that history is gone, the future is unknown, and today is a gift, which is why it is called a present.

beschreibung:
You are in for a treat today. You’re getting The Mel Robbins Podcast on the go!
Last week, my mother-in-law, Judie, walked into our kitchen in Vermont and announced that she’s planning a big adventure, starting on her 90th birthday.
She and her partner, John, have decided to backpack around Europe for a year. I KNOW!!!
Yes, a 90-year-old woman and her boyfriend in his late 80s are shaking things up and backpacking around Europe.
I was dying to know the story behind this decision. So I rounded everyone up - Judie, my husband Chris, and our two dogs, Yolo and Homie - and we headed outside for a walk.
And I grabbed my phone and pressed record to capture the entire thing. Which means you’re coming on the walk with us to hear how this adventure came about. I promise you, you’re going to be so inspired by her message: Don’t wait.
Don’t wait to do the things you’ve been meaning to do.
Don’t wait to call the person you love.
Don’t wait for the perfect time.
Time is ticking, so if there’s something you want to do, make a decision and start figuring out how.
I know you’re going to absolutely love this conversation and be inspired when you're done taking this walk with us.
Chris' dad died almost 20 years ago, so I feel so lucky to still have both of my parents (hi mom and dad!) and Judie alive and in our lives.
I love listening to their stories, hearing how they see the world, and learning from everything they've been through. And the older I get, the more I realize just how much wisdom they have to share.
Today’s message is simple: you get one life. It’s easy to forget that the people we love won’t be here forever. We think we have time, and that’s why we put off so many things. This conversation will inspire you to stop waiting and go for the things you’ve been putting off while you still can.
Time isn’t waiting for us to be ready.
And look, you don't have to do anything nearly as adventurous as what Judie and John have planned for next year.
Maybe there's a friend you've been meaning to call… a place you've always wanted to visit… a class you keep telling yourself you’re going to sign up for… a book you want to write… a business you want to start… or something completely new you'd love to try. Maybe you want to visit your grandson in college or go see your niece's new baby.
When you hear what made Judie decide that NOW is the time for this adventure, you'll understand why now is the time for you to do something too.
I bet as you listen, you'll think of someone who inspires you. Send this episode to them and tell them why.
